translations.web: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
translations.bsb: and cry out at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her. “What city was ever like this great city?” they will exclaim.
translations.kjv: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
translations.asv: and cried out as they looked upon the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like the great city?
